# wallix-bastion_connection_message (Data Source)

Get information on a connection message (login banner or message of the day) of the Bastion.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get the English login message
data "wallix-bastion_connection_message" "login_en" {
  message_name = "login_en"
}

# Get the French message of the day
data "wallix-bastion_connection_message" "motd_fr" {
  message_name = "motd_fr"
}

# Compare the currently configured content against an expected value
output "login_message_check" {
  value = {
    matches_expected = data.wallix-bastion_connection_message.login_en.message == "Authorized access only. All activity is monitored and logged."
    current_message  = data.wallix-bastion_connection_message.login_en.message
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `message_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `message` (String)

## Usage Notes

### Lookup Key

- **message_name**: Which message to read. Must be one of the fixed values `login_en`, `login_fr`, `login_de`, `login_es`, `login_ru`, `motd_en`, `motd_fr`, `motd_de`, `motd_es`, `motd_ru` — the `login_*` variants are shown at authentication time, the `motd_*` variants are the message of the day, each per supported language. Any other value fails validation before a request is even made. The read also fails if the Bastion returns an empty message for that name.

### Returned Attributes

- **message**: The current text content configured for that message/language combination.

There is one message per name/language combination on the Bastion; use multiple data source blocks (as above) to read several languages or message types at once.
